name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: An animated file upload for React and shadcn, with a dropzone, per-file progress and inline reasons for refused files.

meta.details: A dropzone that wakes when files cross the page and lifts as they reach it. Rows rise in with per-file progress on a spring, and refused files are explained inline.

docs: Import FileUpload and useFileUpload from components/eased/file-upload/file-upload. Pass an upload function to report progress; the network call is yours. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
